evidence_gaps: The evidence file reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with generated_epoch=0 and no generated timestamp; fresh-within-2h runtime evidence is unavailable.
No receipt-reconciled, money-weighted realised NET P&L by strategy, chain, route, asset, notional and time window.
No complete cost ledger covering EVM gas, approvals, reverted transactions, priority fees, builder payments and execution failures.
No complete Solana ledger covering base fees, compute-unit priority fees or tips, route impact, realised slippage, refundable versus irrecoverable rent and failed attempts.
No runtime taxonomy separating STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures with transaction-level identifiers.
No quote-to-fill latency, quote staleness, inclusion delay, failure rate or edge-erosion distributions by chain.
No contemporaneous Solana follower round-trip edge and sellability dataset with forward executable exit quotes.
No independent out-of-sample or forward SHADOW sample spanning multiple volatility, congestion and liquidity regimes.
No evidence of wallet-delta reconciliation coverage, duplicate prevention or unexplained balance differences.

Before any promotion, require fresh sanitised runtime forensics, transaction-level receipt and wallet-delta reconciliation, chain-specific all-cost NET P&L, failure-cost attribution, adequate independent observations, positive out-of-sample money-weighted NET P&L with uncertainty bounds, acceptable tail loss/drawdown, and demonstrated simulation-to-fill consistency.

proposals.downside_risk: Receipt reconciliation and classification errors could double-count costs; immutable transaction identifiers and reconciliation assertions are required.

evidence.detail: Windows record aggregate fees, slippage and execution_failures, but do not provide a typed failure taxonomy or explicit gas, priority/tip, price-impact, approval and failed-transaction cost fields.
Quote/simulation results are explicitly research-only, but current persisted economics contain only gross profit, fee and slippage aggregates.
EVM realised accounting deducts gas and builder payment for analysed transactions, providing a basis for extending SHADOW attribution.
Solana landed-but-invalid transactions are counted as execution faults, demonstrating that infrastructure failures can be separated from market outcomes.

proposals.expected_effect: More accurate chain-specific NET P&L, failure-cost ratios and diagnosis of whether negative results arise from the signal or the execution stack.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent daily windows per chain, 200 eligible observations per chain, and at least 50 attempted or counterfactual executions including 20 execution failures where available; report money-weighted NET P&L and failure costs separately.
proposals.rationale: Money-weighted evaluation is unreliable unless every attempt is attributed as STRATEGY_MARKET_LOSS, EXECUTION_INFRA_FAILURE, SUCCESS or NO_TRADE and all irreversible costs are charged. Failed EVM transactions can consume gas; approvals add gas; Solana attempts can consume base fees, priority fees, tips or rent-related cash movements. These must not be hidden inside trade losses or omitted.
proposals.shadow_test: For each SHADOW opportunity and attempted execution, reconcile wallet deltas and receipts into mutually exclusive outcome classes. Require net_pnl = proceeds - capital_cost - venue_fees - slippage - price_impact - gas_or_base_fee - priority_or_tip - builder_or_approval_cost - other_irrecoverable_cost. Stop and fail the test on missing receipts, unexplained wallet deltas, duplicate transaction identifiers, classification ambiguity, or aggregate reconciliation error above 1% of absolute cost.

proposals.downside_risk: A conservative exit-cost envelope may suppress valid opportunities, especially in new pools; inactivity must not be interpreted as failure.

evidence.detail: The entry gate uses reconstructed leader median returns and recent median returns; these are historical signal-quality measures rather than current follower-executable round-trip edge.
The Solana adapter explicitly leaves gross edge, liquidity and sellability at zero because leader events lack a contemporaneous executable future-return quote.
The execution path models current slippage, priority requirements, price deterioration and total fee caps, which can supply execution-cost evidence but not the future exit value.
LIVE routing correctly rejects missing route-level price impact.

proposals.expected_effect: Fewer copied entries whose historical signal appears attractive but whose follower economics are negative; clearer attribution of adverse price movement as STRATEGY/MARKET loss versus quote, RPC, simulation or landing problems as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 500 eligible leader signals across 30 distinct days, 100 forward-observable exits, multiple liquidity regimes, and 95% coverage of entry/exit quotes and fee receipts.
proposals.rationale: A profitable leader history does not establish follower edge after copy latency, entry impact, eventual exit impact, base and priority fees, rent effects and failed attempts. Solana needs a SHADOW-only contemporaneous entry-and-exit cost envelope and must abstain when the exit distribution cannot support positive expected net value.
proposals.shadow_test: At signal time capture entry quote, copy latency, route impact, slippage, base fee, priority/tip, token-account rent treatment and multiple executable exit-size quotes. Compare the existing historical-return gate with a round-trip net-edge gate using forward outcomes without look-ahead. Stop if any required quote or sellability evidence is missing, or if the proposed cohort has non-positive money-weighted NET P&L after all costs or worse tail loss than the baseline.

proposals.downside_risk: Sparse opportunities and chain heterogeneity can make pooled results misleading; results must be stratified by chain, venue, route and notional.

evidence.detail: Cycle simulation reserves gas and configured minimum net profit and performs a final pre-broadcast call.
Gas cost uses a conservative gas-unit reserve and maxFeePerGas or gasPrice.
The live audit records BROADCAST details but the shown schema does not itself establish mined status, realised output, revert gas or complete multi-transaction costs.
EVM features deduct estimated gas and builder fees, while executable status depends on exact quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability and whole-route approval.

proposals.expected_effect: Determines whether quoted EVM edge survives actual inclusion economics and identifies routes whose apparent profitability is consumed by failure costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: Per EVM chain and route family: at least 200 eligible quotes, 50 simulated attempts, 30 mined outcomes where safely available, and 20 observed failure cases or 30 days with zero failures; never pool chains without separate economics.
proposals.rationale: EVM preflight is sound protection but cannot prove realised edge under state competition, base-fee movement, nonce/RPC failures, reverted gas, approval costs or builder leakage. These are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE costs and must remain distinct from a successfully executed route whose market economics lose.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay or observe exact wallet-specific opportunities and compare quoted net edge with receipt-reconciled counterfactual or realised NET P&L, charging approvals, reverted gas, priority fees, builder payments, impact and slippage. Stop a route cohort when cumulative failure costs exceed cumulative successful net profit, median edge erosion consumes the quoted safety margin, or receipt coverage falls below 95%.
proposals.strategy: EVM atomic cycle and learned-route strategies

proposals.downside_risk: Static thresholds may be poorly calibrated across chains and market regimes; runtime evidence is required before changing them.

evidence.detail: Net edge subtracts fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve.
Common eligibility requires positive net edge plus liquidity, sellability and quote-freshness thresholds.
No eligible opportunities are treated as insufficient market opportunity rather than strategy failure, avoiding forced trading.
The code states quote/simulation scorecards are insufficient for promotion without independent future realised evidence.

proposals.expected_effect: Preserves safety and research isolation without asserting profitability.
proposals.minimum_observation: Thirty independent daily windows and at least 200 observations per chain before threshold calibration; promotion additionally requires independent realised out-of-sample evidence.
proposals.rationale: These controls align with abstention when executable edge is absent and prevent raw win count from becoming the objective. They should remain while outcome accounting and runtime evidence are strengthened.
proposals.shadow_test: Retain gates and measure rejection reasons, eligible opportunity frequency, forward money-weighted NET P&L and execution failure costs by chain. Fail any proposed threshold change if it admits non-positive executable edge, weakens liquidity/sellability/simulation protection, or worsens out-of-sample NET P&L.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax filters to improve win count.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count is not the objective, inactivity is valid when no positive executable edge exists, and weaker gates could increase money-weighted losses.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy based on quote simulations or historical leader profit factor.
rejected_ideas.reason: Neither proves realised follower NET P&L after chain-specific execution costs and failures.

rejected_ideas.idea: Pool Solana and EVM performance into one profitability result.
rejected_ideas.reason: The chains have materially different fee, priority, rent, inclusion, approval, atomicity and failure economics.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat landed-but-invalid or reverted transactions as ordinary strategy losses.
rejected_ideas.reason: They are execution/infrastructure failures whose costs and rates must be reported separately from market losses.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository contains useful fail-closed simulation, liquidity, sellability and cost controls, but no fresh runtime forensics support profitability, CANARY readiness or LIVE readiness. Solana leader selection relies materially on historical returns rather than a contemporaneous executable round-trip edge, while EVM and shared SHADOW accounting need fuller attribution of reverted transactions, approvals, priority fees, price impact and other execution leakage. Strategy/market losses must be evaluated separately from execution/infrastructure failures.
